title: IICDEM 2026 International Election Conference & ECINET

items: **Delhi Declaration 2026:** Election Commission of India hosted the International Conference on Democratic Elections and Management (IICDEM 2026) in New Delhi, adopting the 5-pillar Delhi Declaration.
**ECINET Digital Platform:** ECI officially launched **ECINET**, a secure global portal for peer-to-peer knowledge exchange among election management bodies.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → ECI launched the ECINET portal during IICDEM 2026.
